# Closed mapped script effects and unrelated field captions

The fixtures retain the existing detail-consistency and detail-aggregate source algorithms, with one unrelated bound caption/editor added. They exercise a real gap: closed deterministic coverage was discarded when the compiled target used toast or updateControl. The source scripts must remain identical; only title impact analysis may reuse complete, validated statement coverage. A mapped label alone, unknown targets/APIs, changed proof or independent main-field presentation must never grant a fold.
